newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan farmers' body mulls raising gasoline imports.
newsitem.headline: Japan farmers' body mulls raising gasoline imports.

text.p: Japanese agricultural body Zenno is considering importing an additional 5,000 kilolitres (kl) of South Korean gasoline by the end of this year besides its regular monthly imports, a Zenno official said on Wednesday.

Zenno, or the National Federation of Agricultural Cooperative Associations, has been receiving 5,000 kl of gasoline a month from South Korea's Yukong Ltd at its Sendai oil terminal on the Pacific coast since April.
The extra 5,000 kl, if imported, would be delivered to Zenno's Kanazawa oil terminal on the Sea of Japan coast, which was recently revamped in preparation for oil products imports.
Zenno and trading house Itochu Corp entered the gasoline import business following the deregulation of oil product imports on April 1, but only Zenno has been importing gasoline on a regular basis.
